name: Tiagabine
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Thiophene-ring oxidation forms inactive 5-oxo-tiagabine, with glucuronidation also occurring. In-vitro evidence points mainly to CYP3A. Elimination is mainly fecal and urinary as metabolites.
